summary: The registrant, BioHarvest Sciences Inc., filed a Form 6-K reporting a material change: a 4.33 million NIS (approximately US$1.4M) grant approved by the Israel Innovation Authority. This non-dilutive, zero-interest loan supports R&D in AI and data science for plant cell culture. No equity or debt securities were issued. The loan repayment is contingent on future commercial milestones. This is a routine operational grant, not a special-situation corporate event; it does not involve acquisitions, divestitures, restructuring, or any other category listed. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer report on material non-special-situation events.
